name: v1-plus-residual-features
description: V1 baseline + per-platform OLS residual correction with affine, saturation (yr_v1*(v*yr_v1)^2), and steering-rate (d delta/dt) terms.
fallback_behaviour: Unknown platforms (including TESLA_MODEL_3) pass through V1 baseline, which itself falls through to V0 passthrough on Tesla.
